name: print-social-bold-blue-red-cream-coworking-instagram-profile-grid
title: Bold Blue, Red and Cream Coworking Feed
whatItIs: A full Instagram profile for a Brooklyn coworking studio with a circular logo, highlight circles, and a 3-by-3 grid of posts in cobalt, red and cream with tall condensed type, torn shapes, hand-drawn doodles and candid photos.
whatItMeans: A strict three-colour palette and condensed type make a varied grid feel like one energetic brand.
techniques: Cobalt, red and cream only across nine posts
Hand-drawn doodles and arrows as accents

vocabulary.definition: The 3-by-3 block of posts seen on a profile.
A round icon for a group of stories on a profile.
A rough paper-like border on a shape.
